notes.title: Japanese translation patch released for Unhack
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. kagerou01gata over in Japan has kindly translated Unhack into Japanese for us! The patch is available here.



Without Within 1 and 2 were both translated by paid companies, so this is the first fan translation I have received, and I am really grateful for it. We are living in such a wonderful era, where gamers are able to support one another like this.

Thank you so much ːweedyː!
